changelog:
Unify the standalone admin login with console styling, language and theme preferences. Remove the embedded duplicate login, add bounded initialization with retry and session-expiry handling, and preserve HTTP-only sessions and private admin bundles.
登录页统一控制台主题与排版，移除重复登录页；增加加载失败重试、会话过期处理和浏览器回归测试，不改变账号与 API 配置。
